schema: CREATE TABLE Students (student_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, enrollment_year INTEGER, major TEXT); CREATE TABLE Courses (course_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, course_code TEXT, course_name TEXT, credits INTEGER, department TEXT); CREATE TABLE Enrollments (enrollment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student_id INTEGER, course_id INTEGER, semester TEXT, grade TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES Courses(course_id), FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES Students(student_id)); CREATE TABLE Professors (professor_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, department TEXT, hire_date DATE, salary DECIMAL);
